study type: retrospective cohort study (secondary analysis of registry data)
exposure: eclampsia/Hemolysis Elevated Liver Enzymes Low Platelets syndrome (HELLP syndrome)
other variables available at the time of cesarean used in the regression model
outcome: red blood cell transfusion (intra- or postoperative)
cohort: The cohort consisted of 59,468 women who underwent cesarean deliveries, drawn from the Maternal-Fetal Medicine Units Network Cesarean Registry.
finding: A multivariable logistic regression model incorporating variables available at the time of cesarean accurately predicts the need for intra- or postoperative transfusion, with placenta previa and eclampsia/HELLP syndrome being the strongest predictors.
